[[File:Hailfire_homing_missiles.png|thumb|right|250px|Homing missiles on an [[IG-227 Hailfire-class droid tank/Legends|IG-227 Hailfire-class droid tank]].]]
A '''homing missile''' was a special type of missile. The term was used to generally describe many types of weapons, including [[brilliant missile]]s and many types of [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missiles]], as it simply designated a guided missile.

[[File:Homing_Missiles_XWM.png|thumb|left|180px|A pair of homing missiles closing on their target]]

Many types of gunships and transports utilized this type of missile as a strong form of defense against enemy [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] and turrets. [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett's]] [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']] was equipped with homing missiles, and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]] and [[IG-227 Hailfire-class droid tank/Legends|Hailfire droids]] were equipped with a large amount of explosive homing missiles. Those fired by the latter could easily penetrate the [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] plating of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/Legends|Low Altitude Assault Transports]]. Some types of homing missile could be launched and then controlled manually from the cockpit of a starfighter, or from a small computer panel if deployed from a portable [[Missile launcher/Legends|rocket launcher]].

When fired, the missiles tended to "fishtail" as they tracked the target, but unless the target vessel happened to be faster or more maneuverable, or had some sort of defense against missiles, such as flares, aft, or turreted weapons, a miss was rare.
